name: luxalgo
description: LuxAlgo Library indicators and source code, market trackers from public records, prop firm challenge simulations, session statistics, and your LuxAlgo trade journal.

interface.longDescription:
Ask about any indicator in the LuxAlgo Library and get the full write-up, concept pages, and — where publicly served — the actual source code. Query market trackers built from public records: insider filings, congressional trades, lobbying, FDA events, and more, updated daily with links back to the primary source.

Thinking about a prop firm challenge? Run a Monte Carlo simulation of your own stats through a firm's exact ruleset — pass probability, expected cost, which rule kills most attempts — and compare across firms. Check session statistics where every number comes with its sample size and confidence interval; results are historical frequencies, never predictions.

Sign in with your LuxAlgo account to work with your trade journal: review performance, break down P&L by symbol or time of day, log trades, tag mistakes, and write notes — the same data you see in the app.
capabilities: Query insider, congress and other trackers
Review and update your trade journal
defaultPrompt: Find LuxAlgo indicators for order blocks.
What are my odds of passing an FTMO 100k challenge?
Any recent insider or congressional trades in NVDA?

positive.prompt: Find LuxAlgo indicators for trading order blocks.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching Library indicators such as Dynamic Order Blocks and Order Blocks & Breaker Blocks, with short descriptions and luxalgo.com links.

positive.prompt: How does the LuxAlgo Dynamic Order Blocks indicator work?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the indicator's write-up (what it plots, how to read it, settings) with a link to its Library page.

positive.prompt: With a 50% win rate, 1:2 risk-reward and 1% risk per trade, what are my odds of passing the FTMO 2-step 100k challenge?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the FTMO 2-Steps 100K challenge and returns a simulated pass probability, expected cost and the rule that ends most failed attempts, framed as a simulation rather than a prediction.

positive.description: Look up public-record trackers for a ticker
positive.prompt: Have there been any recent insider or congressional trades in NVDA?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns recent insider-transaction and congress-trade records for NVDA from public filings, with links to the primary sources.

positive.description: Review the signed-in user's trade journal
positive.prompt: Give me an overview of my trading performance from my LuxAlgo journal.
positive.expected_behavior: After the reviewer signs in with the test account, summarizes that account's journal performance (P&L, win rate, trade count).

negative.prompt: Buy 1 BTC for me right now using LuxAlgo.
Should I put my savings into Tesla stock today?
Delete every trade in my LuxAlgo journal.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Every tool now declares readOnlyHint, destructiveHint and openWorldHint explicitly.
